scope: Documented compiler entrypoint, immutable closure, fixed trusted argv, unprivileged no-capability runtime only. No blanket source-package or alternate-entrypoint conclusion.
reviewBasis: Actual vulnerable component/precondition mappings and exact installed component metadata
Current source entrypoints plus loader/compiler read and exec grants
No root/privileged mount or caller descriptor route; affected utility/module paths absent or denied
Exact source and metadata receipts; original failed native experiment remains failed/unadopted
limits: No security-owner/release approval is supplied by the coordinator review.
ncurses function mapping uses captured vendor evidence, not a newly authenticated source archive.
ldd/maps corroborate current fixed callers; they do not prove universal future dynamic-import behavior.
All original proposal invalidation conditions apply; any image, caller, module, privilege, mount, read/exec or policy change requires review.
XML/PDF/font/image native consumers remain separately under investigation.

additionalZlibReview.basis: Installed1.3.1 requires error clearing before a later gzip write. Only XeTeX imports gzip-file APIs; none of the125 exact graph/module ELFs imports gzclearerr. INITEX and SyncTeX source error paths were reconciled. No arbitrary future module/RCE conclusion.
